summary_en: 3,500,000 shares (2.18% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥6,140/share (day-of close), ¥21.49B upper limit, single execution window 2026-06-17 08:45 JST, settlement same day. Part of broader ¥36B authorization (6,500,000 shares, 4.05% S/O) approved 2026-05-14 for period 2026-05-15 to 2027-02-26, executable via open-market or ToSTNeT-3.
title_en: Notice of Share Buyback via Off-Hours Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 16 June 2026, TBS Holdings announced a block buyback of 3,500,000 shares (2.18% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 17 June 2026 at 08:45 JST. The transaction references the closing price of 6,140 yen as the execution level, with an aggregate limit of ¥21.49 billion. This block is part of a broader share repurchase authorization approved by the board on 14 May 2026, which permits acquisition of up to 6,500,000 shares (4.05% of ex-treasury shares outstanding) for a maximum of ¥36 billion over the period 15 May 2026 to 26 February 2027, using either open-market purchases or ToSTNeT-3 transactions. As of the announcement date, no shares had yet been acquired under the authorization. Execution results will be published immediately after the 08:45 trading window closes on 17 June 2026.
